editorial.marketOverview: The afternoon rebound remains the latest verified direction. StockTitan's 13:23 ET panel shows QQQ -1.64%, SPY -0.68% and DIA +0.29%, after QQQ was down 4.38% at 11:02. Its article was updated at 15:32 ET but these quotes are not closing prices.
editorial.whatChanged: No new material directional catalyst was verified. Open Watch still contains 178 events, with newest event dated November 23. The forward horizon rolls beyond the completed Wednesday session.
editorial.marketInterpretation: The recovery suggests reduced immediate liquidation pressure but QQQ still lagged SPY by 0.96 percentage points in the timestamped panel. Reuters reports earlier semiconductor and AI credit stress; no verified closing SOX or credit recovery establishes a durable reversal. Earlier paired Treasury yields imply +23.7 bp, not a current curve.
editorial.threeDayPath: Friday November 27 may see relief or renewed selling in shortened trading. Monday November 30 brings normal liquidity and potential weekend oil news. Tuesday December 1 requires confirmation of semiconductor leadership and macro expectations; specific releases and earnings remain unverified.
editorial.bullCase: Holding the afternoon recovery with broader participation and falling volatility would support a relief extension. Underlying AI demand and resilient growth remain potential supports.
editorial.bearCase: A failed rebound, renewed semiconductor liquidation, elevated financing costs or tariff escalation could restore downside momentum. Persistent inflation limits the prospect of monetary relief.
editorial.watchNext: Verify official Wednesday closes, QQQ/SOX relative strength, Nasdaq breadth, VXN/VIX, paired Treasury yields, Brent/WTI and Fed pricing. Thursday is closed and Friday ends at 13:00 ET. Monitor weekend OPEC+ news and confirm next-week macro and earnings dates.
